title: The Uktena and their neighbours
summary: Old debts among the Pure Ones and the Gurahl.

claims.text: The Croatan, the third of the Pure tribes in North America before the Europeans, perished to the last in the destruction of a mighty Bane at Roanoke.
The Uktena have long worked to make amends to the Gurahl for the War of Rage, when Garou hunted and slaughtered the other shapeshifters.
